item.title: Willie Colón, architect of urban salsa music, dies at 75
item.description: Colón, who was nominated for 10 Grammys and one Latin Grammy, made famous songs such as “El gran varón,” “Sin poderte hablar,” “Casanova,” “Amor verdad” and “Oh, qué será.”

item.title: Man shot, killed by U.S. Secret Service, local deputy at Mar-a-Lago after ‘unauthorized entry’
item.description: A man was fatally shot by U.S. Secret Service agents and a local deputy at Mar-a-Lago, President Donald Trump’s resort property in Florida early Sunday morning, authorities said.

item.title: Will I be taxed on my canceled student loan debt?
item.description: For many who had the good fortune of having their loans canceled in 2025, they may be wondering what that means for their tax return.

item.description: The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, “El Mencho, ” on Sunday.

item.title: NJ Transit suspends all service due to winter storm
item.description: (WPHL) -- Citing the winter storm, NJ Transit announced on Sunday that it has suspended service across all modes. The transit agency said all rail service will be temporarily suspended by 9 p.m. Sunday. Hours earlier, all bus, light rail, and Access Link services were also temporarily suspended, beginning at 6 p.m. Sunday. NJ Transit [...]
